tim_s: Heads-up: noticed duplicate PATCH requests from sampleapp when using Retrofit suspend adapter on Android 14 with keep-alive connection flaps. Minimal repro below.

olga_m: can you share repro steps and client config?

tim_s: repro: 1) app calls PATCH /v1/account/settings via suspend service; 2) server returns 401; 3) our OkHttp Authenticator does blocking refresh; 4) trigger brief network blip (toggle wifi) during refresh. Observed two PATCHes reach server after refresh. Client: Retrofit + CallAdapter v2 (suspend), OkHttp retryOnConnectionFailure(true), connection pool keepAlive 5s, dispatcher defaults.

sam_k: makes sense. Authenticator can transparently retry by building a new Request from response.request after getting new auth header. With coroutine adapter, the coroutine may have created/cloned a new Call on resume leading to two underlying Calls if one wasn't canceled. Also keep-alive + connection reuse on flaps can cause the dispatcher to requeue calls.

olga_m: any stack or debug logs?

tim_s: logs: 
2026-03-18 08:12:01 D/OkHttp: --> PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/settings
2026-03-18 08:12:01 D/OkHttp: <-- 401 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/settings (45ms)
2026-03-18 08:12:01 D/Auth: refresh start
2026-03-18 08:12:01 I/Network: wifi disconnected
2026-03-18 08:12:01 I/Network: wifi reconnected
2026-03-18 08:12:02 D/OkHttp: --> PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/settings (replay)
2026-03-18 08:12:02 D/OkHttp: --> PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/settings (duplicate)

sam_k: short-term mitigations: 1) move refresh into an Interceptor with single-flight refresh (AtomicReference/CompletableDeferred pattern) to avoid OkHttpAuthenticator replay semantics; 2) set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) for clients doing streaming or idempotency-sensitive requests; 3) add idempotency keys for PATCH/POST where possible.

olga_m: we should add a short sampleapp fix + doc note. Could also ship a small helper in SDK: TokenRefreshInterceptor that is coroutine-friendly and enforces single-flight. That avoids runBlocking hacks in Interceptor.

tim_s: implemented Interceptor single-flight prototype and duplicates dropped in stress tests. I'll open PR with sampleapp change and a short entry in onboarding docs about Authenticator vs Interceptor and suspend adapter caveats.

devex-bot: Created ticket RED-DEVEX-3471: "Add TokenRefreshInterceptor sample + docs on Authenticator interactions" <https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-DEVEX-3471>

sam_k: also add guidance for using idempotency keys and for disabling retryOnConnectionFailure when callers want strict single-call semantics.

tim_s: will include that in PR notes. Thanks :thumbsup:
